evidence: create_replay's default replay name is "Harold", not "replay". The original copies from 0x4d7a7e with ecx = 7, and the bytes at that address in assets/icytower15.exe are the six characters Harold followed by a NUL -- exactly the seven the rep movsb moves. The neighbouring six-byte header copy was already right and is unchanged: widening it to seven turns two inlined movs into a rep movsb and costs four bytes, which was tried and reverted. 254 of 254 bytes, no gains and no losses, because this removes a literal content difference rather than a codegen one.
